summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Ambassador James Jeffrey, Distinguished Fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy and former US Ambassador to Iraq and Turkey, discusses ongoing negotiations between the US and Iran, focusing on President Trump's repeated ultimatums and threats of escalation. Robert McWhirter, founder of the Law Office of Robert McWhirter, says acting attorney general Todd Blanche’s written pledge to terminate the administration’s $1.8 billion anti-weaponization fund is legally unenforceable, arguing that “a pinky swear has far more force.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China Is Getting More Anxious About Mythos Before Trump Meets Xi
title_cn: 在特朗普会见习近平之前，中国对神话变得更加焦虑
summary: China is growing anxious that Anthropic PBC’s Mythos could be wielded against the world’s second-biggest economy, adding a volatile new issue to already heightened tensions before a planned summit between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.

title: McWhirter: Blanche Pledge Has Less Force Than ‘Pinky Swear’
title_cn: 麦克沃特：布兰奇誓言的力量不如“小指誓言”
summary: Robert McWhirter, founder of the Law Office of Robert McWhirter, says acting attorney general Todd Blanche’s written pledge to terminate the administration’s $1.8 billion anti-weaponization fund is legally unenforceable, arguing that “a pinky swear has far more force.” He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jeffrey: Trump Nearing Limit on Iran Strike Threats
title_cn: 杰弗里：特朗普对伊朗袭击威胁已接近极限
summary: Ambassador James Jeffrey, Distinguished Fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy and former US Ambassador to Iraq and Turkey, discusses ongoing negotiations between the US and Iran, focusing on President Trump's repeated ultimatums and threats of escalation. The former Special Representative for Syria Engagement, who served during Trump's first term, warns Washington is nearing the “end of the tether” in repeatedly threatening military action without following through. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: McMahon Asks Colleges to Pledge Campus Reform by End of 2026
title_cn: 麦克马洪要求大学承诺在 2026 年底前进行校园改革
summary: Education Secretary Linda McMahon is sending a letter Monday to the leaders of US universities asking them to commit to a slate of campus reforms by the end of 2026 in the Trump administration’s latest effort to overhaul higher education.

title: Blanche Strikes Deal With Holdouts to Advance His Nomination
title_cn: 布兰奇与坚持不懈的人达成协议以推进他的提名
summary: Holdout Republican senators are backing a deal with acting Attorney General Todd Blanche to formally rescind an order creating an “anti-weaponization fund” that could have paid $1.8 billion to President Donald Trump’s allies, likely clearing the way for Blanche’s confirmation as the nation’s top law enforcement officer.
